The Continuous Run Dashboard button routes to pmp-continuous-run-dashboard-compressed-v5.html as a standalone clean route with v10 route normalization. This does not remove gates, weaken free-only locks, start Packet 1.5, enable autonomous paid execution, authorize merging, prove hook validation, real app proof, current-clean, frozen, or best-in-world.
